intro: @Overtime || Jeremiah Smith has looked every bit like one of the most dominant young receivers in football, and his matchup with Malachi Toney showed exactly why so many people are calling him a future superstar. Smith’s combination of size, speed, and body control made him almost impossible to guard, as he consistently created separation and made tough catches look easy. Even when Toney stayed in good position, Smith’s athleticism and physicality usually gave him the advantage. Still, Toney deserves credit for competing hard throughout the battle and not backing down against one of the best receivers in the country. He showed solid effort, quick reactions, and flashes of strong coverage ability, but Smith’s talent simply stood out on another level and reminded everyone why he’s considered such a special player. Jeremiah Smith already has experience playing on the biggest stage in college football, helping Ohio State Buckeyes compete for a national championship with big plays and clutch catches. Malachi Toney is still working toward that level, but he has shown a lot of talent and potential for the future. Right now, Smith’s championship experience and success give him the edge and show why he is already one of football’s top young stars. || ib: @Zoggy500 || jeremiah smith or malachi toney edit, jeremiah smith already has one edit || #CapCut #jeremiahsmith #edit #osu #trending @Marcus Kirkendall @Jeremiahsmith_.4
